response.sql: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing sp INNER JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) AS mean_avg_remaingb FROM group_stats) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remaingb, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaingb / o.mean_avg_remaingb AS remaining_ratio FROM group_stats g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
